questions: What is feedback?
If feedback is negative, does that mean the result is bad?
What is backlash?
If there is backlash, does it undo what just changed?
What is slip?
If the slip gets worse, does it always fall over?
What is stability?
If stability is lost, does it have to fall over?
What is precision?
If precision improves, is it necessarily closer to the truth?
What is gain?
If the gain is large, does that mean more money came in?
What is compliance?
If compliance is poor, does that mean the rules were broken?
What is tracking?
If tracking is lost, has anything gone missing?
What is a drive?
If the drive fails, is everything stuck?
What is damping?
If the damping is high, will it be quiet?
What is a state?
If the state changes, has it gone somewhere else?
What is a command?
If a command is ignored, does anyone get punished?
What is a loop?
If the loop is broken, does it stop going around?
Where is home?
If home is lost, can it still find its way back?
What is an observer?
If the observer leaves, is nobody watching?
